therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: MET kinase inhibition + PD-1 checkpoint blockade
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell proliferation inhibition + T-cell activation

results.target_engagement_evidence: Capmatinib Cmax 3260 ng/mL, AUCtau 12800 ng*hr/mL; Spartalizumab Cmax 138 μg/mL, AUCtau 2110 μg*day/mL
biomarker_changes: Spartalizumab ADA prevalence at baseline: 3/18 participants
results.dose_information: Capmatinib 400 mg orally twice daily; Spartalizumab 400 mg IV every 28 days; 6/18 participants had capmatinib dose reductions; median relative dose intensity: capmatinib 99.6%, spartalizumab 100.0%

context.investigator_commentary: Randomized part never started due to poor efficacy in run-in part - 0% ORR, 27.8% DCR, median PFS 1.9 months
